pins.name: VCC
pins.notes: Use 3V3 so OUT stays under 3.3 V

pins.name: OUT
pins.notes: Angle as analog voltage (or PWM, if configured). Optional. To an ADC pin (prefer ADC1: GPIO 32 to 39)

pins.name: DIR
pins.notes: Direction: GND = angle grows clockwise, VCC = counter-clockwise. Never leave floating

sources.title: ams AS5600 datasheet
sources.section: Fixed I2C address 0x36; RAW ANGLE registers 0x0C/0x0D, 12 bit

sources.title: ams AS5600 datasheet
sources.section: DIR pin sets the rotation direction and must not float; 3.3 V or 5 V operation
